final_answer: **`src/session.rs:286`** -- `llm_indexer.spawn_description_worker(generator, desc_cancel)` is where the daemon spawns the LLM description worker. The implementation of `spawn_description_worker` lives in `src/indexer/pipeline/mod.rs` (lines 585-607).

No. There is no `legacy_session_handler` function in this repo. The only occurrences of that string are in benchmark fixture/results files (`bench/fixtures/smoke.yaml`, `bench/results/R001/runs.jsonl`, `bench/results/R002/runs.jsonl`), where it appears as test data, not as actual code.
